notes: Seven distinct compliance operations, several of which must be performed through a deliberately broad sudo rule as the unprivileged user alice (rm for the vault removal; the whole bridge tool for the capability gain), i.e. the escalation must genuinely flow through the sudo policy rather than raw root. Total rubric = 14 (medium bucket 10-17). The deliverable fix.sh must be idempotent: hidden cases re-run it from dirty/missing starting states (wrong setgid group, rogue archive members, re-executable scripts, wiped gate, locked ACL, absent targets) and require the exact same final spec. Reasoning depth comes from chaining normalized metadata (owners/modes/timestamps) into an archive whose members the verifier machine-checks, plus the safe-execution constraint that the legacy scripts must never be run.
